page.overview:
Who is Android 21?

While her good half and 21 were one, Android 21 (Evil) appeared as a black specter, in the silhouette of Android 21 in her base form. She also appeared with a pink and blue aura.

In her true form, she has pink skin, pointed ears with gold hoop earrings, long bushy white-pinkish hair, black nails, red eyes with black sclera, and gains a tail similar to Frieza's. She wears gold bracelets around her neck, wrists, and ankles, a gold ring on her middle finger, white baggy pants with a gold belt, black detached arm sleeves, a black tube top, black ankle heel boots with gold tips.

Upon eating and absorbing Cell, she undergoes a transformation where her skin turns pale purple and she has dark purple spots throughout her body like that of Cell's. Her hair also turns whiteish-purple.

As noted, this side of Android 21 is pure evil, having nothing but a desire to devour all the Z Warriors to satisfy her needs of eating and gaining more power to the point of being seen as nearly insane. However, these desires do not cloud her thinking as she is capable of making rational decisions and assess the situation at hand. Sadistic and sociopathic, 21 will go to extreme lengths to gain the power she desires.
